subject.title: feat(android): record and send voice notes from the chat composer

question: Should maintainers accept this Android async voice-note v1 after the max-duration bug is fixed and real Android record/send proof is supplied, or hold it for a broader mobile voice-note plan?
rationale: This PR adds a new first-party mobile input mode on a protected maintainer-labeled feature; automation can identify the blocker, but maintainers need to confirm product acceptance and proof expectations.

options.title: Proceed after repair and proof
options.body: Keep this as the Android implementation candidate once the max-duration path is corrected and redacted Android device or emulator proof shows recording, finishing, staging, and sending a voice note.

options.title: Require a narrower Android slice
options.body: Ask for a smaller v1 or extra mic/Talk coordination proof before enabling the composer control broadly.

options.title: Pause for mobile voice planning
options.body: Hold this PR and use the linked feature issue to sequence iOS, Android, and follow-up playback/offline behavior together.

recommendation.title: Proceed after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this as the Android implementation candidate once the max-duration path is corrected and redacted Android device or emulator proof shows recording, finishing, staging, and sending a voice note.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the Android implementation and has the strongest recent Android chat/voice history among the inspected candidates.
